sources.title: GitHub - samuelfaj/distill: Distill large CLI outputs into small ...
sources.snippet: Agent command outputs are one of the biggest sources of token waste. Logs, test results, stack traces… thousands of tokens sent to an LLM just to answer a simple question. 🔥 distill compresses command outputs into only what the LLM actually needs. Save up to 99% of tokens without losing the signal.

sources.title: Distillation | How-to guides
sources.snippet: Learn how to distill a large language model into a smaller one using synthetic data generation and fine-tuning, and evaluate the distilled model's performance and efficiency. Discover techniques for distillation, including hard features, logit targets, and feature targets, to transfer knowledge from a teacher model to a student model.
